To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Random Forest algorithm has the highest classification performance (accuracy of 96.67%) for detecting the presence of diabetic Retinopathy.
the proposed method is able to classify the retinal image into three classes, i.e. Normal, Pre-Diabetic Retinopathy and Diabetic Retinopathies with 95% of accuracy.

the proposed method is capable of classifying diabetic retinopathy into normal, mild, severe, and proliferative categories with accuracy of 95.6%, 95.6% and 95.4% respectively, which is better than the existing techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of machine learning techniques to predict the presence of DR in the early stages of the disease.
development of an automated method for screening and detection of Diabetic Retinopaty using machine learning classification.

the development of an automated decision making system that is capable of predicting the presence or absence of diabetic retinopath in retinal images using ensemble machine learning classification algorithms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method can achieve a high level of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in detecting DR.
, Random Forest classifier is the most accurate classifier with 98.3% accuracy and 97.5% specificity.

ensemble of machine learning classifiers can be used to predict the presence of diabetic disease with accuracy of 98% and it is a better alternative for the physical tests used to detect disease in the early stage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed system is able to detect diabetic retinal disease with accuracy 95.2% and 94.5% for training and testing set.
the best performance of 98.5% was obtained by Random forest classifier with 0.05 false positive rate.
we have used ensemble of different machine learning classifiers to detect the diabetic retinopathy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ensemble classification algorithm is more accurate and efficient in detecting the diabetic retinopathy.
ensemble of machine learning classifiers can help in early detection of diabetic retinopathies and can be useful in clinical practice for early treatment.
ensemble learning algorithms can be used to classify diabetic retinopathy and the results are better than individual algorithms.
